#### [Government](https://www.valleycity.us/commission)

City Hall includes an Assessor, Attorney, Auditor, Building/Fire Inspector, City Administrator, City Commission and Forestry Department.

[More Info](https://www.valleycity.us/commission)

#### [Public Works](https://www.valleycity.us/public-works)

Valley City Public Works provides electrical, sanitation, water &amp; sewer services and maintains city streets for Valley City residents.

[More Info](https://www.valleycity.us/public-works)

#### [Fire Department](https://www.valleycity.us/vcfd)

Valley City Fire Department provides fire protection and rescue services within the City of Valley City and works with the Valley City Rural Fire Department to provide services within Barnes County.

[More Info](https://www.valleycity.us/vcfd)

#### [Police Department](https://www.valleycity.us/vcpd)

Valley City Police Department (VCPD) provides law enforcement services for the City of Valley City.

[More Info](https://www.valleycity.us/vcpd)
